summary: Samfine Creation Holdings Group Ltd, a Hong Kong commercial printing foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026. The XBRL-tagged exhibit details prepaid advertising, marketing and consultancy expenses amortized over one to three years, share-consolidation references tied to its October 2024 IPO, customer and supplier concentration disclosures, and a September 8, 2026 equity incentive plan grant. No transaction, offer, solicitation or strategic event is disclosed; this is a routine semi-annual reporting filing with no special-situation or deal terms to monitor.
